tools.description:
Start a session using an optional existing four-digit session_number, or reuse this agent's saved session binding when the number is omitted. Legacy admission permits a new slot only when neither is available. End the current session with action='end'.
Arguments (field? optional; Type? nullable): action:"start"|"end"; session_number?:string (pattern="^[0-9]{4}$")? (default=null).
rules (server): start accepts optional session_number to choose an existing slot; without a number it uses the saved session binding; only Legacy admission permits initial slot allocation; an explicit start reuses the old deadline before cooldown and grants a full duration at or after cooldown; end ends the current session and forbids session_number.
Returns: IssuerStartReceipt{ok:true,session_number:string} | IssuerEndReceipt{ok:true} | RoleFailure{messages_remaining?:union,messages?:union,warnings?:union,postcommit_warning?:union,return_to_chat?:union,intent_warning?:union,ok:false,provider_identity?:union,error:RoleErrorBody,outcome?:union,cmd_hash?:union}.
Errors: input_validation_failed (types, fields, values, conditions); input_admission_failed (oversize/complex input); other domain errors retain their codes in error.code. Validation failures return structuredContent {ok:false,error:{code,reason,path,expected?},outcome:not_committed}.
tools.name: session

tools.description:
Read this agent's unconsumed MCP Events, oldest first, and mark returned events read. With event_id, return one owned event even if read; show_read=true includes previously read events. No agent ID or subscription ID is needed: identity comes from the session binding.
Arguments (field? optional; Type? nullable): event_id?:string(0..36) (pattern="^evt_[0-9a-f]{32}$")? (default=null); limit?:int (>=1; <=20; default=20); cursor?:string(1..512)? (default=null); show_read?:boolean (default=false).
rules (server): event_id and cursor are mutually exclusive; event_id selects one owned event even if already read; without event_id, consume up to limit (1..20) events, ordered oldest first.
Returns: AccessEventsReceipt{ok:true,events:array,next_cursor:union,has_more:boolean} | RoleFailure{messages_remaining?:union,messages?:union,warnings?:union,postcommit_warning?:union,return_to_chat?:union,intent_warning?:union,ok:false,provider_identity?:union,error:RoleErrorBody,outcome?:union,cmd_hash?:union}.
Errors: input_validation_failed (types, fields, values, conditions); input_admission_failed (oversize/complex input); other domain errors retain their codes in error.code. Validation failures return structuredContent {ok:false,error:{code,reason,path,expected?},outcome:not_committed}.
tools.name: get_events
